response.original_title: How Do I Add a Cabin to My Marella Cruises Booking?
response.overview: [Complete 2026 Guide] How Do I Add a Cabin to My Marella Cruises Booking?  To add an entirely separate room or cabin to an existing Marella Cruises reservation, you cannot do it directly within your online account portal; you must book a separate new stateroom and have customer service link the bookings +1(866) 254-7549 (US) or 44-120-420-8151.  Steps to Add and Link a Cabin Book a new stateroom: Go to the Marella Cruises Website to book an additional cabin for your sailing, or call customer service to create a separate reservation +1(866) 254-7549 (US).  Contact customer support: Call Marella Cruises customer service at +1-866-254-7549 (US), or +44-120-420-8151 (UK), contact your travel advisor.  Link your reservations: Provide the separate booking reference numbers to the representative so they can officially cross-link the cabins +1(866) 254-7549 (US).
